messages:
Cassidy Park: FYI USW1-rack9 saw repeated microburst-induced p95 blips from 02:02-02:18. Not classic long-run thermal, more NIC burst + allocator thrash.

Noah Bennett: saw the same. Flow logs show many short-lived high-qps connections from a model ensemble (tid-8888) + a few analytics jobs. Qdisc counters spike then we hit egress policer fallback which creates uneven latency.

Cassidy Park: exact symptom: NIC shaper hits, then allocator moves warm slots -> short lived migrations -> warm-cache cold miss cascade. Bad for everyone.

InfraBot: ALERT rack9-microburst: nic_burst_rate 18/s, egress_policer_hits 47, warm_move_count 23 in 16m. Incident INC-12035 opened.

Rakesh Iyer: quick mitigation idea: enable egress_smoothing_ms on rack level so bursts are amortized, and increase allocation_spread_factor to avoid moving too aggressively.

Emily Zhou: we also have a knob 'burst_window_tokens' per-tenant to limit token burst credit. For ensemble workloads, small per-stream bursts aggregate to big NIC bursts.

Noah Bennett: commands to try now:
```
rackctl set --rack=usw1-rack9 --egress_smoothing_ms=500 --allocation_spread_factor=1.8
tenantctl set --tenant=tid-8888 --burst_window_tokens=1200
```
That smooths the outgoing and reduces aggressive rebalancing.

Cassidy Park: apply but be mindful: smoothing increases tail for genuine low-latency reqs. We should only apply to racks with microburst patterns.

InfraBot: ACTION: rack policy patch queued. Tenant burst_window update applied. Live: https://telemetry.redwood/usw1/rack9/INC-12035

(40s) InfraBot: metrics: nic_burst_rate down 63%, warm_move_count down 70%, p95 tail reduced ~28%.

Rakesh Iyer: nice. Follow-up: propose a new offering "Burst Saver" (short-term charged add-on) that auto-provisions ephemeral dedicated egress lanes for ensembles that need spiky throughput. Cheaper than full reserved slice but charges per-minute while lane is held.

Emily Zhou: need to estimate cost delta and latency improvement. Ops: carve a 200MB/s ephemeral lane -> expected p95 improvement ~40-60ms for collocated tenants.

Noah Bennett: automation idea: if nic_burst_rate > 15/s and egress_policer_hits > 30 for >5m, suggest Burst Saver to tenant with quick opt-in link. If tenant opts, provision ephemeral lane for N minutes and bill.

Cassidy Park: also add an internal safety: do not provision ephemeral lane if rack headroom < 600MB. Region constraint: USW1 low spare zones this week due to maint.

InfraBot: NOTE automation task created: AUTO-2401 (suggest Burst Saver on microburst patterns).

Rakesh Iyer: ops runbook addition: 1) detect microburst pattern, 2) apply egress_smoothing on rack, 3) attempt tenant burst_window clamp, 4) offer Burst Saver if smoothing insufficient, 5) fallback to migration/carveout if >3 offers rejected in 24h.

Emily Zhou: one more: update docs for customers: "Ensembles that fan-out many short requests should either use small per-stream burst windows or opt into Burst Saver/dedicated capacity for predictable SLOs."

Noah Bennett: I'll draft the billing snippet for Burst Saver and a rough pricing per MB/s-minute. Cassidy, can you coordinate a quick bench to quantify p95 gains?

Cassidy Park: on it. I'll run a microburst sim against a canary rack and share numbers. Closing thread after 45m stable. :thumbsup:
